import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette
C_SIGLIP = '#0072B2'       # blue - SigLIP
C_CLIP   = '#009E73'       # green - CLIP (VL pretrained)
C_VLA_T  = '#56B4E9'       # sky blue - VLA trained
C_VLA_U  = '#CC79A7'       # reddish purple - VLA untrained
C_DINO   = '#D55E00'       # vermillion - DINO

# Data: image_mean RSA at peak layer (descending order)
labels = [
    'SigLIP\n+Proj.',
    'CLIP\nViT-L/14',
    'VLA-T\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA-T\nno instr.',
    'VLA-U\nw/ instr.',
    'VLA-U\nno instr.',
    'DINOv2',
]
values = [0.615, 0.557, 0.501, 0.501, 0.485, 0.482, 0.388]
colors = [C_SIGLIP, C_CLIP, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_T, C_VLA_U, C_VLA_U, C_DINO]
hatches = ['', '', '', '///', '', '///', '']

# CI for SigLIP and CLIP
siglip_ci_lo, siglip_ci_hi = 0.526, 0.695
clip_ci_lo, clip_ci_hi = 0.442, 0.660

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

x = np.arange(len(labels))
bars = ax.bar(x, values, width=0.65, color=colors, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.6, zorder=3)

for bar, h in zip(bars, hatches):
    bar.set_hatch(h)

# CI whiskers on SigLIP and CLIP
ax.errorbar(0, values[0],
            yerr=[[values[0] - siglip_ci_lo], [siglip_ci_hi - values[0]]],
            fmt='none', ecolor='black', capsize=4, capthick=1.2, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
ax.errorbar(1, values[1],
            yerr=[[values[1] - clip_ci_lo], [clip_ci_hi - values[1]]],
            fmt='none', ecolor='black', capsize=4, capthick=1.2, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)

# DINO baseline dashed line
ax.axhline(y=values[-1], color=C_DINO, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.text(-0.4, values[-1] + 0.008, 'DINO baseline',
        fontsize=8.5, color=C_DINO, ha='left', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# VL pretraining bracket: group SigLIP + CLIP
vl_left, vl_right = -0.35, 1.35
bracket_y = 0.72
ax.annotate('', xy=(vl_left, bracket_y), xytext=(vl_right, bracket_y),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#555555', lw=1.0))
ax.plot([vl_left, vl_left], [bracket_y - 0.005, bracket_y], color='#555555', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([vl_right, vl_right], [bracket_y - 0.005, bracket_y], color='#555555', lw=1.0)
ax.text((vl_left + vl_right) / 2, bracket_y + 0.006, 'VL pretrained',
        fontsize=8.5, color='#555555', ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# Gap annotation: SigLIP+Proj vs VLA-T w/inst (Δ=0.114)
vla_t_winst = values[2]  # 0.501
gap = values[0] - vla_t_winst  # 0.114
mid_y = (values[0] + vla_t_winst) / 2

bx = 1.7
ax.annotate('', xy=(bx, values[0]), xytext=(bx, vla_t_winst),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#333333', lw=1.2,
                            shrinkA=2, shrinkB=2))
ax.text(bx + 0.12, mid_y, f'Δ = {gap:.3f}',
        fontsize=9, color='#333333', ha='left', va='center',
        fontweight='bold')

# Value labels on bars
for i, (xi, v) in enumerate(zip(x, values)):
    if i == 0:
        offset = siglip_ci_hi - v + 0.015
    elif i == 1:
        offset = clip_ci_hi - v + 0.015
    else:
        offset = 0.012
    ax.text(xi, v + offset, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='medium')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(r'RSA with Action Space ($\rho$)')
